resources.string: Save both configuration files to your PC beside the pairing helper. Start the helper on the PC to attach its Pebrel sessions, then connect here.

Requires Linux, Docker with Compose, and an SSH account allowed to run Docker. Point this domain to the server. Public port 80 must reach the HTTP challenge port; open the HTTPS port as well. Existing unrelated directories are refused.
Check the domain, ports and dedicated installation directory.
Docker with Compose must be installed and accessible to this SSH account.
